specification.objective: Implement GitHub issue #40 by integrating projects, cards/tasks, assignees, and Kanban columns with the existing global audit trail from issue #39, using consistent domain event names, stable card identity, minimal metadata, transaction-safe emission, and tenant isolation without introducing parallel audit infrastructure.

requirements.statement: Project create/update/delete/member add/member remove mutations emit project.created, project.updated, project.deleted, project.member_added, and project.member_removed respectively.
Task/card create/update/delete and assignee mutations emit card.created, card.updated, card.deleted, card.assignee_added, and card.assignee_removed respectively.
Every card event uses entity_type card and includes card_number metadata plus project_id on the audit event.
Kanban card reorder distinguishes cross-column card.moved events from same-column card.reordered events and emits no duplicate event for an unchanged card.
Kanban column create/update/delete/reorder mutations emit kanban.column_created, kanban.column_updated, kanban.column_deleted, and kanban.column_reordered with project and column identity.
Relevant project/card updates use structured minimal metadata describing changed fields without copying decrypted descriptions or other unnecessary sensitive content.
Audit events preserve actor user ID and company ID and remain queryable under the existing tenant-isolated audit API.
The locked POLIS Change Contract for this issue is committed at docs/contracts/project-task-audit-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Project mutations emit the canonical project.* actions with actor, company, project entity ID, success result, and structured metadata where relevant.
Card create/update/delete and assignee mutations emit canonical card.* actions and every event contains card_number and project_id while assignee metadata contains only the stable employee ID.

A cross-column move emits exactly one card.moved event per changed card with fromColumnId and toColumnId, while a same-column position change emits card.reordered with columnId, fromPosition, and toPosition; unchanged cards emit neither event.

Kanban column create/update/delete/reorder emits the four canonical kanban.column_* actions with project and column identity and reorder metadata identifying the prior/new order without full board snapshots.
Rejected cross-tenant or stale operations do not create success audit events, and existing audit query tenant isolation remains valid.
Audit metadata sanitization continues to redact sensitive keys and issue #40 code does not introduce secrets or credentials into metadata.
The target tree contains the locked issue #40 POLIS contract at docs/contracts/project-task-audit-v1.polis.json.

invariants.statement: No new audit table, storage mechanism, query surface, or logger is introduced; AuditService remains the single audit write path.
Existing API, authorization, tenant-scoping, optimistic concurrency, and domain mutation semantics remain unchanged.
Secrets, tokens, credentials, cookies, and unnecessary personal data are not persisted in audit metadata.
A rejected or failed domain mutation does not persist a success audit event.

forbidden_states.statement: Legacy ad-hoc actions such as create, update, delete, assign_member, remove_member, task.*, task.member_*, kanban_column.*, kanban_columns.reordered, or kanban_cards.reordered are emitted by the project/task/Kanban integration after this change.
A card audit event is persisted without card_number or project_id.
A single card movement/reorder produces duplicate domain audit events.
Issue #40 adds an audit persistence mechanism separate from AuditService/AuditEvent.

inputs.statement: Authenticated project, task/card, assignee, and Kanban mutation requests already validated against a company context.
Existing AuditService from issue #39 and existing Project, Task, TaskEmployee, EmployeeProject, and KanbanColumn models.

outputs.statement: Successful project/card/Kanban mutations persist canonical audit events with actor, company, project/entity identity, result, and minimal structured metadata.
Card events include internal card ID, project_id, and card_number; movement and reorder events include the relevant before/after location metadata.
A versioned locked POLIS contract for issue #40 is stored under docs/contracts/project-task-audit-v1.polis.json.

failure_semantics.statement: Existing domain validation, authorization, not-found, conflict, and stale-version failures retain their current HTTP/domain behavior and do not persist success audit rows.
AuditService sanitization and transaction behavior from issue #39 remain authoritative for metadata safety and persistence failures.
